It's $200, but the thing to keep in mind about DNA 200 mods, is that the battery life is rated differently from 18650s. You need to convert it to watt-hours, which people don't get when they see a 900mAh mod like the HFO is. You need to convert it to watt-hours, and a 900mAh 3S battery (11.1V) has about the same battery life as a 2,500mAh 18650 (3.7V) (both come in right at 9.9 watt hours).

There are some 1,300mAh DNA 200 mods out there, but I don't know which ones they are off the top of my head, and those will get you about 1.5 18650s worth.
